title: Verify: AdminApp execution handlers call the client and reload unit tests
summary: Mocked-fetch tests for approve, retry, reject and reload.
description: Add tests/adminActions.test.tsx using the url-routing fetch stub pattern of tests/adminExecution.test.tsx.
acceptance_criteria: Approve/Reject/Retry POST the right URL with Bearer secret
Executions endpoint is fetched again after each action

steps.action: Create jsdom test file with a stubFetch copied in shape from tests/adminExecution.test.tsx; payloads come from tests/fixtures/api.ts (failedExecutionFixture, roundFixture; mirrors ExecutionInfo in src/api/client.ts and the admin execution handlers). Add three tests: FAILED fixture + click Retry asserts POST /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/retry with Authorization 'Bearer secret' and a second GET to /api/v1/admin/executions; same for AWAITING_APPROVAL (fixture spread with status) clicking Approve and Reject.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx
